#ifndef ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_
#define ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_

#include <zephyr/toolchain.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/util.h>
#include <zephyr/ztest_legacy.h> /* For ZTEST_TEST_SUITE_SECTION */
#include <zephyr/kernel.h> /* For k_thread_stack_t, K_THREAD_STACK_DEFINE, etc. if user mode tests are defined here */

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/**
 * @brief Test function signature.
 *
 * @param data User data passed to the test function.
 */
typedef void (*ztest_test_fn)(void *data);

/**
 * @brief Setup/teardown function signature.
 */
typedef void (*ztest_setup_teardown_fn)(void);

/**
 * @brief Structure to define a single unit test.
 */
struct ztest_unit_test {
	ztest_test_fn test_fn;
	const char *name;
	ztest_setup_teardown_fn setup;
	ztest_setup_teardown_fn teardown;
	/* Additional fields for memory domains, user mode, etc. might be here
	 * depending on Zephyr version and configuration.
	 */
};

/**
 * @brief Structure to define a test suite.
 */
struct ztest_test_suite {
	const char *name;
	const struct ztest_unit_test *unit_tests;
	size_t num_unit_tests;
};

/**
 * @brief Macro to define a unit test with optional setup and teardown functions.
 *
 * @param test_fn The test function.
 * @param setup_fn The setup function (can be NULL).
 * @param teardown_fn The teardown function (can be NULL).
 */
#define ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn) \
	{ \
		.test_fn = test_fn, \
		.name = #test_fn, \
		.setup = setup_fn, \
		.teardown = teardown_fn, \
	}

/**
 * @brief Macro to define a unit test without setup or teardown functions.
 *
 * @param test_fn The test function.
 */
#define ZTEST_UNIT_TEST(test_fn) \
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, NULL, NULL)

/*
 * Macros for specific test types (e.g., user mode, memory domains)
 * These would typically expand to ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN with
 * specific setup/teardown functions or attributes. The exact implementation
 * can vary slightly between Zephyr versions.
 */

#ifdef CONFIG_USERSPACE
/* Example for user mode tests. Actual implementation might involve more complex setup. */
#define ZTEST_USER_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn) \
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn)
#define ZTEST_USER_UNIT_TEST(test_fn) \
	ZTEST_USER_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, NULL, NULL)
#else
#define ZTEST_USER_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn) \
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn)
#define ZTEST_USER_UNIT_TEST(test_fn) \
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST(test_fn)
#endif /* CONFIG_USERSPACE */

#ifdef CONFIG_ZTEST_DMEM
/* Example for DMEM tests. */
#define ZTEST_DMEM_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn) \
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn)
#define ZTEST_DMEM_UNIT_TEST(test_fn) \
	ZTEST_DMEM_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, NULL, NULL)
#else
#define ZTEST_DMEM_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn) \
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn)
#define ZTEST_DMEM_UNIT_TEST(test_fn) \
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST(test_fn)
#endif /* CONFIG_ZTEST_DMEM */

#ifdef CONFIG_ZTEST_BMEM
/* Example for BMEM tests. */
#define ZTEST_BMEM_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn) \
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn)
#define ZTEST_BMEM_UNIT_TEST(test_fn) \
	ZTEST_BMEM_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, NULL, NULL)
#else
#define ZTEST_BMEM_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn) \
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn)
#define ZTEST_BMEM_UNIT_TEST(test_fn) \
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST(test_fn)
#endif /* CONFIG_ZTEST_BMEM */

#ifdef CONFIG_FPU_SHARING
/* Example for FPU tests. */
#define ZTEST_FPU_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn) \
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn)
#define ZTEST_FPU_UNIT_TEST(test_fn) \
	ZTEST_FPU_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, NULL, NULL)
#else
#define ZTEST_FPU_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn) \
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(test_fn, setup_fn, teardown_fn)
#define ZTEST_FPU_UNIT_TEST(test_fn) \
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST(test_fn)
#endif /* CONFIG_FPU_SHARING */

/**
 * @brief Macro to define a test suite.
 *
 * This macro defines an array of unit tests and registers the test suite.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite.
 * @param ... A comma-separated list of ZTEST_UNIT_TEST or ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN macros.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE(suite_name, ...) \
	static const struct ztest_unit_test __attribute__((used)) \
	_##suite_name##_unit_tests[] = { \
		__VA_ARGS__ \
	}; \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite_name, _##suite_name##_unit_tests);

/**
 * @brief Macro to define a test suite structure.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite.
 * @param unit_tests_array The array of unit tests for this suite.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite_name, unit_tests_array) \
	static const struct ztest_test_suite __attribute__((used)) \
	_##suite_name##_test_suite = { \
		.name = #suite_name, \
		.unit_tests = unit_tests_array, \
		.num_unit_tests = ARRAY_SIZE(unit_tests_array), \
	}; \
	ZTEST_SUITE_REGISTER(suite_name, &_##suite_name##_test_suite);

/**
 * @brief Macro to register a test suite in the linker section.
 *
 * This macro creates a static const pointer to the test suite structure
 * and places it in a special linker section, allowing the test runner
 * to discover all defined test suites.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite.
 * @param test_suite_ptr A pointer to the ztest_test_suite structure.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE_REGISTER(suite_name, test_suite_ptr) \
	static const struct ztest_test_suite * const \
	_CONCAT(__ztest_test_suite_, suite_name) \
	__attribute__((used, section(ZTEST_TEST_SUITE_SECTION))) = \
		test_suite_ptr;

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_ */
